unknown.label: Status unavailable
unknown.explanation: This status is unknown to this reader. Rebuild the audit with the current MachineChecked version.

formal.accepted.label: formal: accepted
formal.accepted.explanation: The formal propositions and their proofs pass the checks, with current independent correspondence reviews. Source verification and independent replay are separate evidence.

formal.author-reviewed.label: formal: proved, author-reviewed
formal.author-reviewed.explanation: The formal propositions are proved; at least one correspondence review is only by an author of the statements.

formal.review-pending.label: formal: proved, review pending
formal.review-pending.explanation: The formal propositions are proved; at least one correspondence review is missing or stale.

formal.open.label: formal: open
formal.open.explanation: A formal proposition exists, but a required proof is missing or fails a check.

formal.unspecified.label: formal: unspecified
formal.unspecified.explanation: No Lean proposition has been written for this claim.

formal.malformed.label: formal: malformed
formal.malformed.explanation: Corrections are listed without an original clause.

formal.unchecked.label: formal: unchecked
formal.unchecked.explanation: The Lean project was not checked in this build.

definition.unchecked.label: definition: unchecked
definition.unchecked.explanation: The Lean definitions were not checked in this build.

definition.unstated.label: definition: not yet stated
definition.unstated.explanation: No Lean definition has been named for this claim.

definition.review-pending.label: definition: review pending
definition.review-pending.explanation: At least one definition has a missing or stale correspondence review.

definition.author-reviewed.label: definition: author-reviewed
definition.author-reviewed.explanation: At least one definition was reviewed only by an author of the statements.

definition.reviewed.label: definition: reviewed
definition.reviewed.explanation: The definitions have current independent correspondence reviews. This is not a theorem proof.

link.missing.label: linked: Lean declaration not found
link.missing.explanation: The linked declaration was not found in the built modules.

link.definition.label: linked: Lean definition
link.definition.explanation: The linked declaration is a definition, not a theorem proof. Its correspondence with the paper has not been reviewed here.

link.incomplete.label: linked: Lean proof incomplete (sorry)
link.incomplete.explanation: The linked theorem uses sorry. Its proof is incomplete.

link.axioms.label: linked: Lean proof uses further axioms
link.axioms.explanation: The linked proof uses axioms beyond the allowed set.

link.checked.label: linked: Lean proof checked
link.checked.explanation: Lean checked the linked theorem. Its correspondence with the paper has not been reviewed here; independent replay is not recorded.

link.unbuilt.label: linked: Lean not checked (the project is not built)
link.unbuilt.explanation: The project is not built, so the linked declaration has not been checked.

link.module-unbuilt.label: linked: Lean not checked (module not built)
link.module-unbuilt.explanation: The declaration’s module is not built, so the link has not been checked.

link.module-failed.label: linked: Lean not checked (module could not be loaded)
link.module-failed.explanation: The declaration’s module could not be loaded, so the link has not been checked.

link.ambiguous.label: linked: Lean name is ambiguous
link.ambiguous.explanation: Several modules declare this name. Choose a module before checking the link.

link.no-audit.label: linked: Lean not checked here (no audit published)
link.no-audit.explanation: The project declares this link. No published audit establishes a proof or correspondence review here.

link.not-in-audit.label: linked: Lean not checked here (the published audit does not list it)
link.not-in-audit.explanation: The published audit does not list this claim, so it supplies no proof or correspondence evidence for it.

link.suggested.label: suggested link, not confirmed
link.suggested.explanation: A possible correspondence has been suggested but not confirmed.

link.none.label: not linked
link.none.explanation: No Lean declaration is linked to this claim.

formal.refuted.label: refuted as printed
formal.refuted.explanation: Lean proves the negation of an original formal proposition. Correspondence with the printed claim is a separate review.

formal.refuted.open.label: refuted as printed; other clauses open
formal.refuted.open.explanation: Lean proves the negation of an original formal proposition. Other original clauses remain open. Correspondence with the printed claim is a separate review.

formal.refuted.corrected.label: refuted as printed; corrected statement proved
formal.refuted.corrected.explanation: Lean proves the negation of an original formal proposition. A correcting proposition is proved. Correspondence with the printed claim is a separate review.

formal.refuted.corrected.open.label: refuted as printed; corrected statement proved; other clauses open
formal.refuted.corrected.open.explanation: Lean proves the negation of an original formal proposition. A correcting proposition is proved. Other original clauses remain open. Correspondence with the printed claim is a separate review.

scope.expository.label: out of scope: expository
scope.expository.explanation: This claim is classified as expository and is outside the formal proof assessment.

scope.literature.label: out of scope: literature
scope.literature.explanation: This claim is classified as literature and is outside the formal proof assessment.

scope.empirical.label: out of scope: empirical
scope.empirical.explanation: This claim is classified as empirical and is outside the formal proof assessment.

scope.proof-step.label: out of scope: proof-step
scope.proof-step.explanation: This claim is classified as proof-step and is outside the formal proof assessment.

scope.part-of.label: out of scope: part-of
scope.part-of.explanation: This claim is classified as part-of and is outside the formal proof assessment.

scope.duplicate.label: out of scope: duplicate
scope.duplicate.explanation: This claim is classified as duplicate and is outside the formal proof assessment.

link.claim-audit.label: linked: claim audit published
link.claim-audit.explanation: The published audit assesses the claim. That claim verdict does not establish that each named declaration has been proved.

refuted.label: refuted
refuted.explanation: Lean proves the negation of this formal proposition.

open.label: open
open.explanation: A formal proposition exists; a proof is missing or fails a check.

unchecked.label: not checked
unchecked.explanation: Lean was not checked in this build.

stated.label: definition
stated.explanation: A definition is recorded; this is not a theorem proof.

reviewed.label: independent
reviewed.explanation: Current reviews of the proposition and its definitions are recorded by someone other than their authors. Reviewer identity is self-declared.

author-reviewed.label: author only
author-reviewed.explanation: At least one review is only by an author of the statements.

pending.label: pending
pending.explanation: At least one review is missing or stale.

stale.label: stale
stale.explanation: The declaration changed since its review.

unknown.label: not assessed
unknown.explanation: No correspondence review was assessed here.

pass.label: passed
pass.explanation: A structured Comparator record covers this proof and its Lean inputs.

not-run.label: not run
not-run.explanation: No independent kernel replay is recorded for this proof.

unverified.label: unverified
unverified.explanation: The supplied replay record does not establish replay for this proof and build.

pass.label: matched
pass.explanation: The claim’s source hash matches the inventory. This does not establish paper-to-Lean correspondence.

fail.label: mismatch
fail.explanation: The source differs from the pinned source.

none.label: not checked
none.explanation: The claim’s source has not been verified.

pdf-only.label: PDF only
pdf-only.explanation: There is no LaTeX statement hash; PDF integrity and placement are reported separately.

none.label: none
none.explanation: No locked statement evidence is recorded.

n/a.label: not applicable
n/a.explanation: Locked statement is not required for this clause.

none.label: none
none.explanation: No exact statement evidence is recorded.

n/a.label: not applicable
n/a.explanation: Exact statement is not required for this clause.

none.label: none
none.explanation: No allowed axioms evidence is recorded.

n/a.label: not applicable
n/a.explanation: Allowed axioms is not required for this clause.

n/a.label: not applicable
n/a.explanation: Witness is not required for this clause.

n/a.label: not applicable
n/a.explanation: Regimes is not required for this clause.
